newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Red Cross says offices burned, looted in Albania.
newsitem.headline: Red Cross says offices burned, looted in Albania.

text.p: Red Cross offices and stores across Albania have been burned down and looted during the violence that has swept the country in the past few days, the humanitarian movement said on Friday.

A report from the Geneva-based International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC), which unites national organisations around the globe, said armed men had also attacked the Albanian Red Cross headquarters in Tirana.
"Several local Red Cross branches around the country have been looted and burned down," the IFRC said in its weekly news bulletin.
"The Tirana warehouse has been completely emptied of its stocks. Seventy tonnes of food, medicines, medical equipment, tents and stretchers were stolen," it added.

At the start of the current disturbances, the IFRC said, Red Cross volunteers had provided hospitals in the southern part of the country with syringes, medicine, bandages and surgical items to treat the injured.
It had also provided first aid and transported the injured to hospital.
Now, the bulletin added, the national society's headquarters in the capital had lost touch with volunteers in the provices because most phone lines had been cut.
